name: Proteus
def: Amazon's first fully autonomous warehouse robot, a flat low base that lifts wheeled GoCart containers and moves them through areas shared with staff.
body: Proteus is a low profile mobile robot that drives under a wheeled GoCart of packages, lifts it and hauls it between sortation and outbound dock areas. Earlier Amazon floor robots worked inside fenced fields, while Proteus uses onboard perception and a projected light field to move safely in open aisles alongside employees. It navigates without floor tape or barcode grids and is coordinated as part of a larger fleet inside Amazon fulfillment and sortation buildings.
Proteus is Amazon's first floor robot safe to roam freely among workers, glowing a green beam as it slides beneath carts; it marks the merger of the Kiva lineage with modern perception.
facts: Announced in June 2022 as Amazon's first fully autonomous mobile robot
Built to work in the same floor space as employees rather than in a caged field
Moves the wheeled GoCart containers used for packages in outbound docks
specs: Low profile drive base that tunnels under wheeled carts and lifts them
Lidar, cameras and safety scanners paired with a projected light field
Onboard perception and fleet coordination with no floor infrastructure or fencing
